payload.reason: The evidence provides specific morphological features associated with different word types, such as nouns and verbs, and discusses their roles in linguistic annotation and translation performance.

claims.text: Nouns have morphological features including case, number, and gender, while verbs have person, number, tense, and aspect.
Different features, including morphological features, help distinguish between subjects and objects in German sentences.
Lemmas are included as a linguistic feature to improve generalization over inflectional variants of words.
Subword tags encode the segmentation of words into subword units, which are derived from original word-level features.
